create_random_product_manifold_points: create random points on a product manifold by sampling each submanifold and packing them into a ManifoldTensor
compute_base_logprob_product_manifold: compute the base log probability of a point on a product manifold by summing per-submanifold log probabilities
normalize_metric_product_manifold: normalize tangent vectors on a product manifold by applying metric normalization across each submanifold independently
clamp_abits_product_manifold: clamp binary representation of points on a product manifold by applying abits_clamp to each submanifold
compute_conditional_velocity_product_man: compute conditional velocity and interpolated points along geodesics on a product manifold using JVP across submanifolds
